script: Heavy floods this week forced thousands of families to leave their homes. Rescue teams are still reaching some villages, and officials have confirmed that several people lost their lives. Schools and community halls have been opened as shelters, where volunteers are serving hot food and clean water. Doctors are visiting the camps to check on children and older people. If you would like to help, local charities are collecting blankets and dry food. Our thoughts are with every family who has lost someone.
